description: Creates or updates the store's own stock locations. A location keeps the id it is given, such as default; one without an id is matched by its name.

items.description: A stock location the store keeps units at.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: The location's name, such as Main warehouse.

Address.description: The location's address, as one line of text.

Position.description: The location's place in the list: orders take units from the first locations first.

OwnerKind.description: Leave empty. A location owned by another record, such as an asset's, belongs to that record and is skipped.

Locations.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.
